title: Authentication failures
summary: auth-gateway login failures began at midnight with no application deployment

logs: auth-gateway ERROR x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
auth-gateway ERROR upstream identity-provider TLS handshake failed
deployments: No auth-gateway or identity-provider deployments in the previous 72 hours

runbooks.title: Expired service certificate
runbooks.content: For a sharp midnight increase in TLS failures without a deployment, inspect certificate expiration. Rotate the certificate, reload the dependent service, and verify the complete chain.

oracle.root_cause: The auth-gateway upstream identity-provider certificate expired at midnight, causing TLS handshakes and logins to fail.
